title: General n-set Inclusion-Exclusion Formula with Formal Induction

problemStatement.formal: Formalize finite-set inclusion-exclusion, including two- and three-set sieve formulas, a general finite-family inclusion-exclusion theorem, and applications to totients, surjection counts, derangements, Stirling numbers, Bell numbers, and Mobius inversion on subset lattices.
problemStatement.plain: Turn inclusion-exclusion into a reusable Lean toolkit: prove the base formulas, generalize them to finite families, and verify several standard counting applications.
whyMatters: Inclusion-exclusion is one of the main engines of finite combinatorial counting.
The formalization connects abstract finite-set identities with concrete arithmetic and enumerative examples.
The subset-lattice Mobius inversion view shows the same principle in a more structural form.

proven: Two- and three-set inclusion-exclusion formulas are proved for finite sets (Lean: two_set_inclusion_exclusion, three_set_inclusion_exclusion).

A general finite-family inclusion-exclusion theorem and derived two-, three-, and four-set forms are included (Lean: general_inclusion_exclusion, two_set_from_general, three_set_from_general, four_set_inclusion_exclusion).
The OQ01 file proves sieve formulas and totient identities, including multiplicativity and prime-power formulas (Lean: sieve_two, sieve_three, totient_mul_coprime, totient_prime_pow').
Surjection counts, derangement values and recurrences, alternating binomial sums, and divisor-totient sums are verified (Lean: surjectionCount, derangements, altBinomSum, divisor_totient_sum).

The subset-lattice Mobius inversion companion proves zeta/Mobius transform facts and an inclusion-exclusion summary (Lean: mobius_inverts_zeta, ie_as_mobius_inversion, mobius_subset_lattice, ie_mobius_summary).
knownResults.goal: Document the verified inclusion-exclusion toolkit and its finite-counting applications.
